name: sample-rust-plugin
description: This is a sample plugin for Obsidian (https://obsidian.md)

scripts.wasm: wasm-pack build --target web && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('pkg/obsidian_rust_plugin_bg.wasm.d.ts', { force: true })"
scripts.build: yarn run wasm && tsc -noEmit -skipLibCheck && node esbuild.config.mjs production
scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
